messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads up — since ~02:45 UTC we	are seeing outbound webhook delivery failures for Private (VPC) onboarding flows. Impact: onboarding stuck, activation callbacks not received, some trials could hit expiry. I	have a list of ~9 affected tenants. Need customer comms + replay plan + renewal-risk triage. @Owen can you draft a short note?

Owen Martinez: Drafting now. Short + clear. Posting below for edits.

Owen Martinez: Hi <Customer> \u2014 we	are currently investigating delayed onboarding activations for Private deployments caused by failed webhook deliveries. We	have identified the root cause and applied a fix; activations for most affected tenants should complete within 45	60 minutes. If you need an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and we	will prioritize you. We	will follow up with an RCA and compensation where impact meets our SLA.  Redwood CS

Mei Wang: Tech update: root cause is a regression in the vpc-egress-agent (v2.4.1) that started dropping retries after a protocol change. Retries were capped incorrectly and headers were stripped for some destinations. I pushed a hotfix (revert + retry-cap bump) and rolled a patch to affected regions.

Priya Nair: ETA to clear the backlog? Any risk of duplicate deliveries or data corruption?

Mei Wang: Backlog drain ETA ~20	60min per tenant depending on queue. Replays are idempotent on delivery side so duplicates are safe; no data corruption expected. I	kicked manual replays for high-touch tenants already.

Jorge Rivera: I		will open office hours at 09:30 UTC for any customers who want realtime help. I		will also prepare a KB doc and a short FAQ. Link: https://kb.redwood.internal/vpc-onboard-webhook-failures (draft)

Priya Nair: Please include a one-question feedback link in the follow-up: "Did the communication and replay meet your expectations? (Yes/No)" Also we should flag tenants with onboarding >48h as renewal-watch and surface to renewals queue.

cs-bot: [notice] replay-job queued: tenant_id=9982 job=repay-2026-03-24-77 status=queued

Owen Martinez: Sending first batch to affected customers now. Message I	m posting: ```Hi there  we detected delays in onboarding callbacks for your Private deployment due to a webhook delivery issue. We	applied a fix and expect activations to finish within 45	60 minutes. If you	need an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com. We	will follow up with a technical RCA and proposed credits if applicable.  Owen, Redwood CS```

Mei Wang: Manual replay steps for CS/Enablement (internal):
```
# Manual replay
1) POST https://internal.replay/api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN"
2) watch logs: kubectl -n vpc-{tenant_id} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
3) verify delivery: SELECT * FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
```

Jorge Rivera: CRM action: marking affected tenants and adding note "onboarding webhook delay - monitoring - renewal-watch if >48h". I		added office hours invite and a calendar for follow-ups.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Actions summary: Owen 
draft/send comms (in progress), Mei 
RCA + telemetry graphs (ETA EOD), Jorge 
KB + office hours + CRM flags, Priya 
exec summary + renewal queue handoff. Please add anything else here.

Owen Martinez: Added survey link to follow-up and sending second batch in 15m.

Mei Wang: Replays running; progress looks good. No integrity issues. Will post traces to the RCA doc shortly.

Priya Nair: I		ll prepare the customer-facing RCA in lay terms once Mei	posts the telemetry. Tag me when ready.

cs-bot: [action] replay-job tenant_id=9982 status=running job=repay-2026-03-24-77

Jorge Rivera: Noted the renewal-watch workflow. We	have one mid-market tenant that will be escalated if activation not done in 36 hours.

Priya Nair: Good catch. Jorge, please prepare a tailored outreach script for that account and mark as high-touch.

Owen Martinez: Will do. Sending update to the queue now.
